scopes.r_ads: Read an authenticated member's ad accounts
scopes.rw_ads: Read and manage an authenticated member's ad accounts
scopes.rw_dmp_segments: Access and manage DMP Segments (Audiences program)
scopes.rw_conversions: Create/retrieve conversion rules, stream conversion events
scopes.r_liteprofile: Retrieve name and photo of authenticated user

1_campaign_management.title: Campaign Management APIs
1_campaign_management.description: Build and manage ad campaigns on LinkedIn including accounts, campaign groups, campaigns, and creatives.

1_1_ad_accounts.title: Ad Accounts API
1_1_ad_accounts.description: Create and manage Ad Accounts for advertising campaigns. Maximum 5,000 campaigns and 15,000 creatives per account.

getAdAccount.description: Fetch a single ad account by ID

updateAdAccount.description: Partial update of an ad account

deleteAdAccount.description: Delete a DRAFT ad account. For non-DRAFT, set status to PENDING_DELETION via partial update.
deleteAdAccount.note: Only billing admin can delete accounts

searchAdAccounts.description: Search for ad accounts with cursor-based pagination

batchCreateAdAccounts.description: Create multiple ad accounts in a single request

testAccounts.description: Test Ad Accounts for development without serving real ads
constraints: Maximum 1 test account per developer application
Cannot convert existing account to test

1_2_campaign_groups.title: Campaign Groups API
1_2_campaign_groups.description: Manage status, budget, and performance across multiple related campaigns. A default campaign group is auto-created with each Ad Account.

searchParameters.search.status.values: ACTIVE, ARCHIVED, CANCELED, DRAFT, PAUSED, PENDING_DELETION, REMOVED

deleteCampaignGroup.note: Only DRAFT groups can be hard deleted. Others: set status to PENDING_DELETION.

1_3_campaigns.title: Campaigns API
1_3_campaigns.description: Create and manage advertising campaigns that define ad schedule, budget, targeting, and creative delivery.

campaignTypes.TEXT_AD: Text-based ads in right column or page top
campaignTypes.SPONSORED_UPDATES: Native ads in LinkedIn feed (Carousel, Video, Lead Gen)
campaignTypes.SPONSORED_INMAILS: Personalized inbox messages with CTA button
campaignTypes.DYNAMIC: Personalized ads using member profile data (Follower, Spotlight, Jobs)

searchParameters.search.status.values: ACTIVE, PAUSED, ARCHIVED, COMPLETED, CANCELED, DRAFT, PENDING_DELETION, REMOVED

autoBidding.optimizationTargetType: MAX_IMPRESSION | MAX_CLICK | MAX_CONVERSION | MAX_VIDEO_VIEW | MAX_LEAD | MAX_REACH

statusValues.ARCHIVED: Inactive, hidden in UI until un-archived
statusValues.DRAFT: Still being edited, not eligible to serve

1_4_creatives.title: Ad Creatives API
1_4_creatives.description: Create, manage, retrieve, update, and delete ad creatives. Supports multiple ad formats including text ads, sponsored content, message ads, dynamic ads, event ads, and video ads.

createInlineCreative.description: Create creative with inline content (e.g., Direct Sponsored Content)

deleteCreative.note: Only DRAFT creatives can be hard deleted. Others: set intendedStatus to PENDING_DELETION.

review.description: Review status: PENDING, APPROVED, REJECTED, NEEDS_REVIEW

supportedAdFormats: Sponsored Content (images, videos, carousels, articles, text)

1_5_account_access_controls.title: Account Access Controls API
1_5_account_access_controls.description: Assign roles and functions to users for campaign and creative data access.

roles.VIEWER: View campaign data and reports only
roles.CAMPAIGN_MANAGER: View data/reports, create/edit campaigns and ads
roles.ACCOUNT_MANAGER: View data/reports, create/edit campaigns and ads, manage user access
roles.ACCOUNT_BILLING_ADMIN: Full permissions including billing. Must be exactly one per account.

2_ad_targeting.title: Ad Targeting APIs
2_ad_targeting.description: Control which audiences see ads using professional demographic targeting. Targeting is set at campaign level.
2_ad_targeting.requiredScope: No additional OAuth permissions needed (requires Marketing API Program approval)

getEntitiesByFacet.description: Get specific targeting values within a facet

getEntitiesByTypeahead.description: Search targeting entities by partial text match

parameters.entityType: AGE, COMPANY, FIELD_OF_STUDY, INDUSTRY, SCHOOL, SKILL, TITLE, etc.

getSimilarEntities.description: Find targeting entities similar to provided URNs

getEntitiesByURNs.description: Get metadata for specific entity URNs

2_2_audience_counts.title: Audience Counts API
2_2_audience_counts.description: Get the number of member accounts matching targeting criteria. Minimum 300 members required for campaigns.

responseFields.active: Active member count (more likely to visit LinkedIn)
responseFields.total: Total member count (0 if audience < 300 for privacy)

2_3_ad_budget_pricing.title: Ad Budget Pricing API
2_3_ad_budget_pricing.description: Get pricing metrics (minimum, maximum, and suggested bids) based on targeting criteria.

parameters.dailyBudget: Daily budget for suggested bid calculation

2_4_ad_supply_forecasts.title: Ad Supply Forecasts API
2_4_ad_supply_forecasts.description: Forecast impressions, spending, clicks and other metrics based on targeting criteria, campaign settings, and time periods.

3_reporting_and_analytics.title: Reporting and Analytics APIs
3_reporting_and_analytics.description: Performance insights including clicks, impressions, ad spend, and professional demographic information at account, campaign, and creative levels.

3_1_ad_analytics.title: Ad Analytics API
3_1_ad_analytics.description: Core reporting API with three finder methods for different levels of analysis.

analytics.description: Single pivot grouping for performance data

parameters.pivot.value: ACCOUNT, CAMPAIGN, CREATIVE, MEMBER_JOB_TITLE, MEMBER_SENIORITY, MEMBER_INDUSTRY, MEMBER_COMPANY, MEMBER_COMPANY_SIZE, MEMBER_JOB_FUNCTION, MEMBER_COUNTRY_V2, MEMBER_REGION_V2, SERVING_LOCATION, CARD_INDEX, IMPRESSION_DEVICE_TYPE, etc.
parameters.dateRange.end: Inclusive end date (optional, defaults to today)

statistics.description: Supports up to 3 pivots for multi-dimensional analysis

attributedRevenueMetrics.description: Revenue attribution data from CRM integrations

revenueAttribution.revenueWonInUsd: CRM revenue attributed to LinkedIn ads

limitations.demographicTopValues: Top 100 values per creative per day
limitations.fieldProjections: Request specific metrics to avoid throttling

3_2_utm_tracking.title: UTM Tracking Parameters API
3_2_utm_tracking.description: Retroactively modify URLs in shares to include UTM parameters for tracking marketing success.

endpoint.description: Update share URL with UTM parameters

4_matched_audiences.title: Matched Audiences APIs
4_matched_audiences.description: LinkedIn's centralized Data Management Platform (DMP) for identifying and reaching target audiences. Generates mappings between advertiser data and LinkedIn member profiles.
4_matched_audiences.accessNote: Restricted to vetted, approved LinkedIn developers. Apply via interest form.

4_1_dmp_segments.title: DMP Segments API
4_1_dmp_segments.description: Staging entities that accept user information, map to LinkedIn profiles, and output Ad Segments.

transitions: ARCHIVED → BUILDING: Updated or added to active campaign
ARCHIVED → EXPIRED: Unused for 90 days total

4_2_dmp_segment_users.title: DMP Segment Users API
4_2_dmp_segment_users.description: Add or remove users from a DMP Segment. Wait 5 seconds after creating a segment before adding users.
4_2_dmp_segment_users.validationRules: Must provide at least one valid ID OR valid firstName AND lastName

4_3_dmp_segment_companies.title: DMP Segment Companies API
4_3_dmp_segment_companies.description: Add or remove companies from a DMP Segment. Wait 5 seconds after creating a segment before adding companies.
4_3_dmp_segment_companies.requiredFields: At least ONE of: companyName, organizationUrn, companyWebsiteDomain/companyEmailDomain, companyPageUrl

4_4_dmp_segment_destinations.title: DMP Segment Destinations API
4_4_dmp_segment_destinations.description: Add destinations (ad exchanges) to a DMP Segment.

responseFields.status: BUILDING, UPDATING, READY, FAILED, ARCHIVED, EXPIRED
responseFields.matchedCount: Matched input entities from last 7 days (when READY)

4_5_dmp_list_uploads.title: DMP Segment List Uploads API
4_5_dmp_list_uploads.description: Upload first-party data as CSV files to create targeting segments.

step1_createListFile.description: Create a CSV file with company or contact data

step5_attachList.note: Only one list upload per DMP segment

4_6_ad_segments.title: Ad Segments API
4_6_ad_segments.description: Collections of entities (members or companies) for ad targeting, auto-created after DMP matching.

optionalFilters.statuses: BUILDING, UPDATING, READY, FAILED, ARCHIVED, EXPIRED

4_7_website_retargeting.title: Website Visitors Retargeting API
4_7_website_retargeting.description: Retarget website visitors using the LinkedIn Insight Tag.

step4_applyToCampaign.description: Update campaign targetingCriteria with dynamicSegments facet

4_8_predictive_audiences.title: Predictive Audiences API
4_8_predictive_audiences.description: Combine first/third-party data with LinkedIn's predictive AI to build high-intent audiences.
4_8_predictive_audiences.note: Geo filter must be present in targeting criteria

seeds.description: Conversions, matched audience segments, or ad leadgen forms

5_audience_insights.title: Audience Insights APIs
5_audience_insights.description: Discover, analyze, and understand target audiences using LinkedIn's professional data.
5_audience_insights.accessNote: Private API - requires special approval via application survey

requirements.targetingMustInclude: geo or profileGeo + one additional targeting attribute

6_media_planning.title: Media Planning APIs
6_media_planning.description: Forecast reach, impressions, and leads over budget for informed budget allocation before spending.
6_media_planning.accessNote: Private API requiring qualified developer access

responseFields.leadCurve: Array of lead generation curve points

7_conversions.title: Conversions APIs
7_conversions.description: Server-to-server connection for conversion tracking and campaign optimization across online, offline, and custom touchpoints.

accessMethods.directAccess: Generate tokens from Campaign Manager (no developer app needed)
accessMethods.partnerAccess: Apply via Developer Portal with OAuth

userIdTypes.SHA256_EMAIL: SHA256 hash of lowercase email without whitespace

rateLimits.recommendation: Use batch requests to avoid throttling

validation.userIdRequirement: At least ONE valid user identifier required
validation.userInfoRequirement: If included, must contain both firstName AND lastName

8_lead_sync.title: Lead Sync APIs
8_lead_sync.description: Automatically collect and sync leads from LinkedIn Lead Gen Forms to customer platforms.

coreApis.leadNotifications: Create webhook subscriptions for Lead Form responses

9_company_intelligence.title: Company Intelligence API
9_company_intelligence.description: Company-level engagement data for all companies engaged through LinkedIn, including engagement score, impressions, clicks, and leads.
9_company_intelligence.accessNote: Private API requiring special access request

urnEncoding.description: URNs in query parameters must be URL encoded

rateLimits.retryStrategy: Exponential backoff (start seconds, double each retry, max 5 minutes)
